new_findings.title: Worker ignores nonzero stale-sweep reports
new_findings.defect: The worker discards the SweepReport and only logs exceptions. A sweep that returns stalled=true and exit_code=1 is committed without a warning, hiding the unresolved reservation from worker logs.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A stale reservation returns REJECTED for every no-progress batch; sweep_stale_reservations returns exit_code=1 while the reservation stays RESERVED, but the worker commits and emits no error. Its counters remain held until a later sweep or operator intervention.
new_findings.fix: Capture the report and log a warning with exit_code and rejected/fail_closed/no_progress counts when it is nonzero, while preserving successful settlements. Add a schedule test for a returned nonzero report.

summary: All six listed corrections hold in code and have targeted assertions, including forced-RLS PostgreSQL coverage; one worker caller hides nonzero sweep reports. The requested unit suite timed out in the sandbox's aiosqlite worker, and PostgreSQL tests could not run here.
